messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a concise list of Canada’s statutory holidays for 2023, grouped by province/territory.  
(If you need the exact dates for each holiday, let me know and I’ll add them.)

| Province/Territory | Statutory Holidays (2023) |
|--------------------|---------------------------|
| **Alberta** | New Year’s Day, Family Day, Good Friday, Canada Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving Day, Remembrance Day, Christmas Day |
| **British Columbia** | New Year’s Day, Family Day, Good Friday, Canada Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving Day, Remembrance Day, Christmas Day |
| **Manitoba** | New Year’s Day, Louis Riel Day, Good Friday, Canada Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving Day, Remembrance Day, Christmas Day |
| **New Brunswick** | New Year’s Day, Saint John’s Day, Good Friday, Canada Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving Day, Remembrance Day, Christmas Day |
| **Newfoundland & Labrador** | New Year’s Day, St. Patrick’s Day, Good Friday, Canada Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving Day, Remembrance Day, Christmas Day |
| **Northwest Territories** | New Year’s Day, Good Friday, Canada Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving Day, Remembrance Day, Christmas Day |
| **Nova Scotia** | New Year’s Day, Nova Scotia Heritage Day, Good Friday, Canada Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving Day, Remembrance Day, Christmas Day |
| **Nunavut** | New Year’s Day, Good Friday, Canada Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving Day, Remembrance Day, Christmas Day |
| **Ontario** | New Year’s Day, Family Day, Good Friday, Canada Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving Day, Remembrance Day, Christmas Day |
| **Prince Edward Island** | New Year’s Day, Islander’s Day, Good Friday, Canada Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving Day, Remembrance Day, Christmas Day |
| **Quebec** | New Year’s Day, Saint-Jean-Baptiste Day, Good Friday, Canada Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving Day, Remembrance Day, Christmas Day |
| **Saskatchewan** | New Year’s Day, Saskatchewan Day, Good Friday, Canada Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving Day, Remembrance Day, Christmas Day |
| **Yukon** | New Year’s Day, Good Friday, Canada Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving Day, Remembrance Day, Christmas Day |

Let me know if you’d like the specific dates or additional details!
